Name: Bigger Vanilla Slime Hutch
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32684/]Slime Hutch Water Spots[/url].

Optional furnishings, water trough placement options - however, it has to be kept within the original slime hutch dismensions from the top left corner for it to work.

But why, you might ask, did you keep the number of water troughs even, so you can't put a sprinkler to fit all pretty there? Answer: because I am utterly deranged and think it's funny (and more faithful to vanilla uwu)

The screenshot features a number of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] mods, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18394]More Skin Tone Options[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Medieval Craftables[/url].

Note: does not come with a sprinkler, that one's from my save.

Note 2: it's easy to add more water trough configurations, the furniture would require some more work but is fuly doable. You can ask me to make your dream trough, or do it yourself ^^

Note 3: shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6455]Change Slime Hutch Limit[/url] which goes great as a companion mod for this one!

Downloads.Description: Because the 1.6 Slime Hutch Water Spots mod straight up isn't working, adding a new default water spot arrangement that matches vanilla and actually works :\

Manifest.Description: Increases the size of the slime hutch
